validation.times: Set a start and an end time.

restore.notice: Picked up where you left off: unsaved changes from {when} are back in the form.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: What people see first: the name, the address, the story, the artwork.
basics.name: Event name

when.title: When
when.description: Times are stored in UTC and shown to everyone in the event's own zone.
when.publishedNote: Changing the time of a published event emails every attendee.

where.title: Where
where.description: Where people turn up, or the link they join.
where.addressHelp: Pick a suggestion to fill city, country and map coordinates.
where.mapPin: Map pin set from the address ({lat}, {lng}). Pick another suggestion to move it.
where.joinLinkHelp: Only shown to confirmed attendees, in their confirmation and reminders.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Who can find the event, and how many can come.

visibilityHelp.public: Listed on Discover and indexed by search engines.
visibilityHelp.unlisted: Anyone with the link; not listed or indexed.
visibilityHelp.private: Only people with an invite link.

options.title: Registration options
options.description: Approval, guests, reminders, fees and refund policy.
options.approvalHelp: People request to join; approve or reject them from Attendees.
options.phoneHelp: Optional field with SMS opt-in for tickets and reminders.
options.guestsHelp: Each guest gets a separate ticket.
options.waitlistHelp: Visitors can queue; you offer spots from the Waitlist tab as seats free up.
options.feePassThroughHelp: Cloud edition: show the 0.99% as a line item.
options.refundPolicyHelp: Shown at checkout for paid tickets.

links.title: Links
links.description: Social links shown on the event page.
links.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No links yet} one {# link} other {# links}}

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: People shown on the event page.
hosts.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No hosts yet} one {# host} other {# hosts}}
hosts.name: Host name

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: Logos appear on the event page in this order.
sponsors.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No sponsors yet} one {# sponsor} other {# sponsors}}
sponsors.name: Sponsor name

bar.createNote: Nothing is public until you publish.
bar.editNote: Changes go live as soon as you save.

fields.title: Registration form
fields.description: Name and email are always asked. Your own questions can apply to the registrant, the whole order or each guest, and can appear only when an earlier answer matches.

empty.title: Just name and email
empty.description: Add a question when you need something more — a dietary note, a company, a t-shirt size.

fields.question: Question
fields.keyHelp: Column name in exports and the API. Lowercase, underscores.
fields.fileNeedsS3: File upload needs S3 storage configured on this instance.
fields.fileUnavailable: S3 storage is not configured, so registrants cannot upload this file. The form shows it as unavailable.
fields.optionsHelp: One per line. Use “value | Label” to store a different value.
fields.condition: Show only when an earlier answer matches
fields.dependNote: A question may only depend on one positioned above it.

ticketTypes.title: Ticket types
ticketTypes.descriptionEmpty: Publishing without a ticket type creates a free General admission ticket automatically.
ticketTypes.descriptionGuests: What people can buy, and how many of each. Guests pay the same price as the registrant's ticket.
ticketTypes.description: What people can buy, and how many of each. A price of 0 means free.

empty.title: No ticket types yet
empty.description: Add one for each thing people can buy — early bird, standard, students.

dialog.description: Price in {currency}. Set quantity for a limited run.

discounts.title: Discount codes
discounts.description: Percent or fixed amount off the order. Buyers enter the code at checkout; it applies to every ticket in the order.

empty.title: No discount codes
empty.description: Codes are the easiest way to run an early bird, a partner rate or a friends-and-family price.

discounts.confirmDelete: Delete code {code}? Orders that already used it keep their discount.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.description: One link per guest, or one link for everyone. Each invite tracks how many times it has been used.
invites.privateNote: This event is private: only people who open an invitation link (or members of your organization) can see it and register. Email invites only work with the address they were sent to.
invites.publicNote: Invitations only restrict access on private events. This event is {visibility}, so anyone with the link can register; you can still send invites as a courtesy.

form.help: Leave the email empty for a shareable link anyone can use.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.description: Create one above to hand out a link, or address it to a single email.

invites.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? The link stops working immediately.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.description: The queue that forms once the event sells out.
waitlist.enabledNote: When the event sells out, visitors can join this list. Promoting someone holds one seat for them for 24 hours and emails a claim link; unclaimed seats go back to the pool.
waitlist.disabledNote: The waitlist is off for this event (Edit → Registration options). People who joined earlier are still listed here.

empty.title: Nobody on the waitlist
empty.description: People queue here once every ticket is gone. You decide who gets the next free seat.

waitlist.lapsed: Offer lapsed; can be promoted again
waitlist.confirmRemoveOffered: Remove {email} from the waitlist? Their held seat is released.

refund.confirm: Refund {amount} in full? Tickets on this order stop working and the seats are released once Stripe confirms.

chart.summary: {total, plural, one {# registration} other {# registrations}} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
chart.aria: Registrations per day. Peak {max} on a single day, {total} in total.

scanner.progressQueued: {pct}% of confirmed tickets · updated {time} · {count} waiting to sync
scanner.offline: Offline: scans are saved and synced later

camera.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this site, or use Search to check people in by name.
camera.unsupported: This browser can't use the camera. Use Search, or paste a ticket link below.
camera.point: Point at the QR code on the ticket

scanner.manualPlaceholder: Or paste a ticket link / code
